title: Correct final expression
description: Essential: The answer must be exactly or equivalently written as d⟨I²⟩/df = 4kTR / (R² + 4π²f²L²).

title: Impedance magnitude squared
description: Important: The solution must correctly compute |Z|² = R² + (2πfL)² for the series RL circuit.

title: Apply AC Ohm's law
description: Important: The relationship ⟨I²⟩ = ⟨V²⟩ / |Z|² must be stated or correctly used.

title: Substitute spectral density
description: Important: The given spectral density d⟨V²⟩/df = 4kTR must be substituted into the current expression.

title: Units or dimensional check
description: Optional: A check that the final expression has correct dimensions (A²/Hz) can be included.

title: Incorrect impedance handling
description: Pitfall: Using Z = R + iωL without taking the magnitude squared, leading to an expression like 4kTR/(R + iωL)².

title: Missing frequency dependence
description: Pitfall: Omitting the inductive reactance term, resulting in a constant d⟨I²⟩/df = 4kT/R.
